customer_message: How do I invite a teammate and set their role?
agent_reply: Happy to help! Go to Settings > Members > Invite, enter their email, and pick a role from the dropdown before sending. They'll get an email to join. Anything else I can help with?

customer_message: I need to downgrade my plan before renewal.
agent_reply: Sure - you can change your plan under Settings > Billing > Plan. Pick the new tier and it takes effect at your next renewal date, so you won't be double-billed. Want me to walk you through which tier fits your usage?

customer_message: Can I get a receipt for last month's invoice?
agent_reply: Absolutely - you can download it under Settings > Billing > Invoices, then click the download icon next to the month you need. Let me know if you'd like it emailed instead.

customer_message: Where do I find my API key?
agent_reply: You'll find it under Settings > Developer > API Keys. Click 'Reveal' to see it or 'Generate new key' to rotate it. Keep it secret - treat it like a password.

customer_message: How do I add more seats to my plan?
